title: Answer: a biological feature of brains, subjective in its ontology

statements.text: Consciousness is a biological feature of certain organisms, caused by neurobiological processes and realized in the brain, with a subjective, first-person ontology, in the same sense of biological in which digestion is.

sources.locator: p. 6, quoting The Rediscovery of the Mind, pp. 92-93
sources.quote: Consciousness is, thus, a biological feature of certain organisms
